blocks.html: Join the students of De La Salle University – Dasmariñas as they showcase their skills and present various products in the annual Entrep Corner exhibit from April 17 till May 6 in Robinsons Place General Trias. Led by 4th year Entrepreneurship students, this year’s Entrep Corner exhibit carries the theme “Heat Wave: Summer Bazaar” and features different brands with their own treats for the mall-goers from 12 student companies. The exhibit is the students’ 3rd retail experience, coming from previous retail experiences in Robinsons Place Las Piñas and Robinsons Place Manila. As graduating students, becoming involved in the exhibit will help them improve their entrepreneurial skills as they prepare to venture out in the real world and start their own businesses. This experience will also hone their marketing skills making them more business-minded individuals. Various types of people will like the different products offered by the students. Techies will frequent Array as it offers affordable and accessible differently designed tech accessories such as earphones made from scrap leathers. Food enthusiasts will enjoy the delicious and affordable meals from Dipsidoo which offers pizzas with different types of dips such as Hawaiian, pure beef, pepperoni and bacon. Other choices include the Crackers Crunchy Lasagna with their home-made lasagna dressed in many flavors such as chicken pesto, tuna pesto, beef Bolognese and a lot more. For the dessert section of the exhibit, go to Cream Section to taste a combination of the traditional Taho flavor topped with ice cream and Frost Bakes which sells cake-filled-ice cream of different flavors. #BOTD (Burger of the Day), Doughlicious, Freggies, Itsy Bitsy, Let It Snow, PasTime and Tasty Tater has their own delectable treats in store that will surely satisfy everyone’s taste buds. Robinsons Malls Entrep Corner is a Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) project that provides college students, taking up Entrepreneurship or a business-related course invaluable retail experience in a Robinsons Mall.
